exposure: Type of nursing care (quantitative evaluation-based preventive care vs. routine care)
preventive nursing based on quantitative evaluation
finding: Preventive nursing based on quantitative assessment effectively controlled blood glucose levels in GDM patients and improved their social support, resilience, coping style, and maternal-infant outcomes compared to routine care.
mod_finding: The proportion of cesarean deliveries was significantly lower in the group receiving quantitative evaluation-based preventive nursing care compared to the control group.
